reviewSamples.author: Photo of Michael Thompson
reviewSamples.text: Corey from Easy Electrical was a pleasure to work with. He came out quickly and provided options and a quote on the same day. He was always punctual and provided updates via text. The team is highly professional and skilled. They treated my home and my family with respect and I would not hesitate to recommend them in the future.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Gary G
reviewSamples.text: Corey with Easy Electrical was great to work with.   He ran wires and installed two ceiling fans with lights on our porch. They were on time and very professional while they were here.  They made sure everything was cleaned up and was put back when they left.  I highly recommend them.
